full_details: The Monday copper was on. Galls, copperas, and gum. You ate at threepence. The loaf was a penny, a finger and a half short, and she did not put it on a scale. You told the table the supper's bill and did not divide it. At two you were an old Roman. You were done when the fourth act began, and you did not come on again. Pope had asked Garnish: your name is not on tomorrow's Shrew. Heminges said the Rose has the first part of Hercules at two. You said you would go over. At six, home, you said it again. Tomorrow the Shrew is theirs. You will stand in the yard.
one_sentence: You played an old Roman in Titus, dead by the fourth act, and at six you meant to stand in the Rose yard tomorrow for Hercules.
title: An old Roman in Titus, and the Rose tomorrow
